name: @knennigtri/aep-tag-tool
description: Export and Import Adobe Experience Platform Tags (previously Launch) with optional variable updates based on Organzations
author: Kevin Nennig <nen.devpr@gmail.com>

scripts.preversion: git fetch --tags && npm run lint && npm run test:noLogs
scripts.build: npm run updateTOCs && npm install && npm ci && npm i --package-lock-only && depcheck ./
scripts.release:beta: npm version patch && npm run publish:beta
scripts.test: node tests/auth-config.test.js && node tests/export-filename.test.js && node tests/cli-output.test.js && node tests/delete-preview.test.js && node tests/settings-yaml.test.js && node tests/async-api.test.js && node tests/tests.js
scripts.test:noLogs: node tests/auth-config.test.js && node tests/export-filename.test.js && node tests/cli-output.test.js && node tests/delete-preview.test.js && node tests/settings-yaml.test.js && node tests/async-api.test.js && node tests/tests.js -- --hideconsole
